title: Fixed Inverted Roof and Central Drain Spine Canopy
description: One complete newly authored fixed inverted-roof canopy. Two full finite roof wings fall inward toward one full-length open U-profile valley trough, instead of meeting at a raised ridge. Three single-piece Y-shaped supports stand beneath the centre line on full grounded feet; their branches meet the wings while the entire outer perimeter remains unposted. A separate hollow rear downpipe is a visible static architectural detail. This straight inward-folding topology and central branching support arrangement differ from the old four-corner anticlastic saddle canopy, raised monitor strip, hip roof and new three-sawtooth factory bay. All ten complete closed meshes are newly authored; no old canopy, post or roof mesh imported or transformed. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metre-style Z up, horizontal bounds-centred ground origin, one architecture model zero scenes. Static artistic assembly only. The valley has no bottom pipe penetration and the downpipe does not certify a hydraulically connected drainage system. No seating, people, enclosed building, rigging, animation or interaction.
